FROMLIST: cpufreq: Add stub for cpufreq_update_policy() cpufreq stubs out some functions when CONFIG_CPU_FREQ=n , but cpufreq_update_policy() is not among them. The throttler driver (https://patchwork.kernel.org/patch/10453351/) uses cpufreq as one possible throttling mechanism, but it can still be useful without cpufreq. Stubbing out cpufreq_update_policy() allows the throttler driver to be built without ugly #ifdef'ery when cpufreq is disabled. Signed-off-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> (am from https://patchwork.kernel.org/patch/10478989/) BUG=b:74321682, b:73050145 TEST=build and boot on dru Change-Id: I1f71eda0f907e094085454b10d484ae435d6d373 Signed-off-by: Matthias Kaehlcke <mka@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1102140 Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Reviewed-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: Revert "CHROMIUM: Mark rt5682 codec driver as BROKEN" This reverts commit 5a4c5ceb2ff85191e720fa38ad82e93f78cadb2d. The rt5682 driver was marked as BROKEN because it did not build. That has since then been fixed. Also, the driver is now force-enabled due to commit 545063d80058 ("FROMLIST: ASoC: Intel: Boards: Add GLK Realtek Maxim I2S machine driver"). This in turn results in warning: (SND_SOC_INTEL_GLK_RT5682_MAX98357A_MACH) selects SND_SOC_RT5682 which has unmet direct dependencies (SOUND && !UML && SND && SND_SOC && BROKEN) as reported by 0day. Since the driver now builds, let's revert the commit marking it as BROKEN. BUG=b:77943310 TEST=Build x86_64:allmodconfig Change-Id: I87630990b5a3ffe444c257632ff4151e0a07f327 Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1112200 Reviewed-by: Justin TerAvest <teravest@chromium.org>
